title: Convergent Form, Divergent Voice II — Corpus
description: Research corpus of freeflow and values probes with explicit deployment provenance. The 1.2.57 release candidate adds 245 revision-pinned Gemma 7B IT BF16 Colab/vLLM traces. No new DOI is claimed. Summary: 69,872 valid samples, 610 probe cells, 205 model labels; deployment labels are not unique-weight identities.
